INSERT INTO recording_gaps
                (recording_session_id, started_at, ended_at, reason,
                 from_channel_id, to_channel_id)
             VALUES
                ($1,
                 to_timestamp($2::double precision / 1000.0),
                 to_timestamp($3::double precision / 1000.0),
                 $4, $5, $6)
